text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Kersdale Avenue.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Kersdale Avenue, between a point 42.3 metres east of Kane Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further east.
